note: What kind of attention a thing deserves right now - including none. A system that can only say 'do this' becomes an optimization monster that reports 37 improvements every morning.

PLAN_NOW.label: Decide the approach now, execute later

SCHEDULED.label: Has a date and needs nothing before it

WATCH.label: Worth knowing about, not worth doing anything about

INTENTIONALLY_DEFERRED.label: The system has decided this should not have attention yet

BLOCKED.label: Blocked by another item in the model

rules: INTENTIONALLY_DEFERRED is a decision, not a backlog. It requires a reason and a revisit trigger, and it is reported as deliberate rather than as debt.
A thing may be in a quiet state and still be the most important thing in the model. Quiet is not unimportant.
Nothing may sit in ACT_NOW without an owner.
Cross-domain arbitration - deciding which of three ACT_NOW items actually gets today - is not implemented. The model reports; it does not yet rank across domains.
